# App Forge

App Forge is a tool that helps you manage tasks, track projects, collaborate with your team, and sync everything across your devices.

Use it when you need tasks, projects, and team collaboration in one app. It provides:

- Task management with due dates and priorities
- Project tracking with progress bars
- Team collaboration with comments
- Cross-device sync with offline mode

## Installation

1. Download the installer from our website.
2. Run the installer.
3. Follow the setup wizard.

## Features

- Task management with due dates and priorities
- Project tracking with progress bars and milestones
- Team collaboration with comments and file sharing
- Offline mode so you can work without internet
- Custom themes and dark mode

## Quick Start

```bash
npm install app-forge
```

Then log in and create your first task.

## API

| Endpoint | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `/api/login` | Logs you in |
| `/api/tasks` | Gets your tasks |

The documentation lives at `docs/API.md`, the tutorial at `docs/tutorial.md`, and the changelog at `CHANGELOG.md`.
